Eli (infra): Kicking off a short tracking thread for GPU surge remediation items from the postmortem. I'll keep this tight. Please confirm owners/ACs.
Tasha (sre): Thanks. List ACs so we can mark Done cleanly.
Eli (infra): Items: 1) reserve backstop + emergency override; owner=Tasha; due=2026-04-08; AC=allocs rejected >=95% reserved, override token requires 2 approvers, PagerDuty if sustained rejects >2/min.
2) scheduler safe defaults + prewarm hook; owner=Mei; due=2026-04-01; AC=staging stress shows no global preempt spike, <2% perf regression.
3) short-term headroom predictor + one-region dashboard; owner=Jonas; due=2026-04-12; AC=forecast MAPE<16% 24h + runbook ramp command.
4) borrow approval drill + OpsBot flow; owner=Eli; due=2026-04-09; AC=one simulated borrow via /ops borrow-approve with audit entry.
Tasha (sre): I'll take item 1 and add unit tests. PR when ready.
Mei (scheduler): Taking 2. I'll expose /scheduler/prewarm and adjust packing_factor->0.72. Will run staging on 2026-03-28.
Jonas (capacity): Taking 3. Will prototype EWMA+hour-of-day features, dashboard link to follow by 2026-04-06.
Eli (infra): OpsBot, add /ops borrow-approve (2-approver) and tag detector incidents as "surge-patrol".
OpsBot: automated-message: /ops borrow-approve created (2 approvers required). Incidents from detectors tagged "surge-patrol". Audit logging enabled.
Tasha (sre): Quick Q: do we exclude spot pools from the backstop?
Eli (infra): Yes, exclude spot/backfill. Update AC accordingly.
Mei (scheduler): PR draft: https://git.redwood/example/pr/9001 (scheduler prewarm + packing default). Staging run scheduled 2026-03-28.
Tasha (sre): PR draft: https://git.redwood/example/pr/9002 (reserve backstop + override token). I'll add canary gating.
Jonas (capacity): Dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood/d/wxyz/headroom-patrol (prototype panels).
Eli (infra): Weekly check-ins Thursdays 9:30 PT. I'll close items here when ACs met. Keep canary windows minimal.
OpsBot: automated-message: followup-tracker created; owners assigned: Tasha, Mei, Jonas, Eli. Next automated reminder in 7 days.
